system.summary: Period table: one sign per letter (numbers 24, 13, 16, 15, 14 for the vowels, symbols for consonants), a second sign for d, e, i, o written above, user's homophones a = 12, e = 18; the letters also use code numbers (22, 75, 99 ...) not on the table.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the signs on the table (20 + 4 above + 3 noted); the letters use further signs and code numbers.

prior_solution.where: The period table (Ms 1580 f. 239) and the period interlinear decipherments and later marginal notes on Ms Granvelle 62

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout asked the Bibliothèque municipale de Besançon for f. 239 as the probable key of the Saint-Amour letters (04 Nov 2026) and received it free on 18 Nov 2026; Claude transcribed, pre-registered and ran the test.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Scan of Ms 1580 f. 239 requested from the Bibliothèque municipale de Besançon; received free for research on 18 Nov 2026. Ms Granvelle 62 from Mémoire Vive.
Table transcribed twice (full agreement); cipher passages of Ms Granvelle 62 transcribed blind by a fresh agent (474 signs), hashed.

Pre-registered single measure (lexical coverage of the decode vs 200 shuffled-value controls): M 0.710 vs max 0.685; criterion M >= 0.85 and M >= max + 0.30 not met. Measure not discriminating on a text cut by code numbers.
After the measure: decoded words coincide with the period interlinear decipherments (img379-381) and later marginal notes (img382, img390).
Repository, web search (CCFr records, Granvelle cipher literature): no edition or decipherment of the 1626 passages found.

outcome.method_basis: The key is the period table; the passages carry partial period decipherments; no reading made. Pre-registered test failed.

gaps.item: code numbers (22, 75, 99 ...) and shapes off the table

gaps.detail: not attempted beyond the mechanical decode; next step

outcome.notes: EXISTING material: period key and period decipherments. The pre-registered test FAILED and is reported as such. No image of the Bibliothèque municipale de Besançon is reproduced.

texts.label: Ms Granvelle 62 ff. 322-334: ciphered passages of Saint-Amour's letters to Cantecroy, Oct-Dec 1626
texts.summary: Letters 'du camp' of the Count of Saint-Amour to the Count of Cantecroy (12 Oct - 18 Dec 1626); the decoded words (paix, offert, artifice, la commission de l'ambassade, faveur en Espagne, la Royne est grosse in a later note) point to peace talk and Madrid news; not read.
